1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Cook three foods with broad ready windows and widely separated target times. Foods may be cooked one at a time.
1.natural_language: Cook all three foods until they glow golden, then move them to the serving tray. You may cook them one at a time.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Cook the current six foods with their current 2.3 to 2.7 second ready windows. Foods may be cooked one at a time.
2.natural_language: Cook every item until golden, then move it to the serving tray.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Cook six foods with narrower ready windows, and start any three within 2.6 seconds so several clocks must be monitored together.
3.natural_language: Cook every item until golden and serve it. Start any three foods within 2.6 seconds of the first start.

4.label: hard
4.summary: Start all six foods within three seconds, monitor their overlapping visual states, and serve through 1.5 to 1.7 second ready windows.
4.natural_language: Run a full dinner rush: start all six foods within 3 seconds of the first start, then serve each while it glows golden.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Start eight foods within 3.2 seconds and manage closely spaced deadlines through 1.1 to 1.3 second ready windows.
5.natural_language: Run the packed grill: start all eight foods within 3.2 seconds of the first start, then serve each during its brief golden glow.

simplified.summary: Select a food, then use the visible START COOKING and MOVE TO TRAY buttons.

full.summary: Drag each food directly from the raw order to the live grill and then to the serving tray.
